## Validation

Report `./scripts/check` and the behavior exercised. For interface changes, include both languages, both themes, mobile layout, and keyboard focus. State any checks or platform behavior that remain unverified.

## Documentation impact

Link the affected guidance, or explain specifically why no documentation changes are needed. For migrations or persistent-format changes, describe compatibility, upgrade, backup, rollback, and isolated validation. Keep supported behavior and current development status honest. See [contributor guidance](https://github.com/iuliandita/foldout/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md); the impact check routes each affected area to a review document or a specific explanation. For each area without a review document update, add `Docs impact: <Area>: none - <specific reason>` with at least 20 characters in the reason. Areas: Configuration, CLI, API, Database, Backup and encryption, Reader, Integrations, Build and web assets.
